behavior: Referenced user table must precede relational constraints in a clean test bootstrap, preserving native Django migrations and PostgreSQL integrity.
execution_flow: Native MigrationLoader marks test_orm migrated -> swappable user dependency -> base0001 creates res_users -> test_orm0001 creates two current model tables and relations -> normal remaining migrations and post_migrate.
inputs_outputs: Empty exclusively owned PostgreSQL database; current app registry with two managed test_orm models; expected res_users, discussion/category/M2M tables and validated moderator FK. Repeated migrate is idempotent.
side_effects: Adds native initial migration; no manual permanent SQL/table, disabled FK, removed model/test, workflow bypass or parallel migration engine. Probe creates/removes only its randomly named owned database/role/HBA.
dependencies: PostgreSQL16 own fixture, verified container; no shared QA recreation
consumers: Django test database preparation, pytest-Django CI, current TestOrmDiscussion.moderator and participants relations
installed_mechanism: Migration generated by frozen Django6.0.5 for current registered models, native dependency graph and native legacy --fake-initial verification.
existing_adaptation: Odoo module dependency/late FK contract expressed through Django migration edges. Does not copy the Odoo installer or declare the whole test_orm corpus ported. GEN0312 port-closure wording does not authorize speculative migrations for unregistered models; this fixes currently installed schema only.

equivalence: Bounded schema ordering proven, not complete Odoo module installation or functional acceptance.
limitations: Shared installations were not migrated. Existing tables need verified matching schema before authorized native --fake-initial; it is not a blanket schema repair. No full native Odoo runtime executed. Session fixture/flush teardown remains failed; no full pytest/CI acceptance. The flush body was not changed; exposure/fixture interaction needs independent control, not automatically labelled preexisting.
